hostDfHonesty: df on a Docker named volume often reports the backing filesystem (commonly all of /var/lib/docker), not isolated object-bytes. Prefer mc du / quota info via --used-bytes.
entitlementHttpEndpointReason: Hard cap is AIStor bucket quota. Host watermarks are a second guard. Entitlement must not mount docker.sock or the MinIO data volume. Products enforce S3 quota errors and this JSON locally until a later internal endpoint is wired to the same schema.
productWiring: Honor S3 quota / InsufficientCapacity errors from the origin. Also poll or exec the status JSON on the host. Deny PUT when the matching admit.* flag is false. Always allow DELETE and trial.purge.
